name: orb_index_aligned_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's first 15 minutes (09:15–09:30) is the overnight information absorption window where FII hedges, pre-open auction imbalances, and gap-fill orders are digested into a defined price range. When NIFTY closes above that range's high with 3+ consecutive 5-second bars, it signals that buy-side institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms have exhausted all resting supply at the ORB ceiling and are continuing to accumulate — the same institutional flow tailwind the original strategy used an index-alignment filter to detect. VWAP confirmation (close > VWAP) ensures the breakout is aligned with the dominant session bias rather than a counter-trend spike. At 5-second resolution we enter within 15 seconds of breakout confirmation, capturing the first impulse leg before TWAP algos pause for rebalancing.
core_signal_oneliner: 15-minute ORB breakout confirmed by 3 consecutive 5s closes above range high plus VWAP alignment and VIX regime gate
